name: syncLISData
shortDescription: Exchanges lab results and updates medical records with an external LIS (Laboratory Information System).
description:
Overview

This function integrates with an external Laboratory Information System (LIS) to exchange lab results and update patient medical records within the HMP. It ensures that diagnostic information is accurately reflected.

Intended use

Invoked as an event handler, typically after a MedicalRecord (e.g., a lab order) is created or updated, or when new lab results are received from the LIS. It pushes or pulls relevant data.

Logic

  1. Receive event data related to a MedicalRecord, specifically for lab results.
  2. Transform the HMP data structure into the format required by the external LIS or parse incoming LIS data.
  3. Make an authenticated API call to the LISSystem using ctx.service('LISSystem') to exchange lab results.
  4. Update the relevant MedicalRecord entries with new lab results using ctx.data.update.
  5. Handle potential API errors and log the synchronization attempt and its outcome using ctx.audit.log.
  6. Return a success or failure status.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • AuditLog

External Services

  • LISSystem
